snippet.title: Neo Trick! Trailer
snippet.description:
NeoTrick is an addictive deck-building game! Exclusively for the PlayDate! Each round you'll be delicately balancing dealing enough damage to the firewall and stealing enough money to spend in the shop! Card's can permanently affect other cards. Increasing their power or adding new effects will carry into future rounds. 

Earn card packs from playing well and open them in-between runs to fill out your collection. Then modify your starting deck and try different combinations to increase your odds of a  successful run!
